versos.hebraico: לֵ֣ץ הַ֭יַּין הֹמֶ֣ה שֵׁכָ֑ר וְכָל־שֹׁ֥גֶה בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א יֶחְכָּֽם׃

controles.web: Wine is a mocker, and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
controles.kjv: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
controles.livre: O vinho é zombador, a bebida forte é causadora de alvoroços; e todo aquele que errar por causa deles não é sábio.

versos.hebraico: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר אֵ֣ימַת מֶ֑לֶךְ מִ֝תְעַבְּר֗וֹ חוֹטֵ֥א נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

controles.web: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
controles.kjv: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
controles.livre: O temor ao rei é como um rugido de leão; e quem se ira contra ele peca contra sua própria alma.

versos.hebraico: כָּב֣וֹד לָ֭אִישׁ שֶׁ֣בֶת מֵרִ֑יב וְכָל־אֱ֝וִ֗יל יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃

controles.web: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife; but every fool will be quarreling.
controles.kjv: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
controles.livre: É honroso ao homem terminar a disputa; mas todo tolo nela se envolve.

versos.hebraico: מֵ֭חֹרֶף עָצֵ֣ל לֹא־יַחֲרֹ֑שׁ ישאל בַּקָּצִ֣יר וָאָֽיִן׃

controles.web: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
controles.kjv: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
controles.livre: O preguiçoso não lavra no inverno; por isso ele mendigará durante a ceifa, pois nada terá.

versos.hebraico: מַ֣יִם עֲ֭מֻקִּים עֵצָ֣ה בְלֶב־אִ֑ישׁ וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנָ֣ה יִדְלֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
controles.kjv: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
controles.livre: O conselho no coração do homem é como águas profundas; mas o homem prudente consegue tirá-lo para fora.

versos.hebraico: רָב־אָדָ֗ם יִ֭קְרָא אִ֣ישׁ חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִ֣י יִמְצָֽא׃

controles.web: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
controles.kjv: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
controles.livre: Muitos homens, cada um deles afirma ter bondade; porém o homem fiel, quem o encontrará?

versos.hebraico: מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֣וֹ צַדִּ֑יק אַשְׁרֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו אַחֲרָֽיו׃

controles.web: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
controles.kjv: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
controles.livre: O justo caminha em sua integridade; bem-aventurados serão seus filhos depois dele.

versos.hebraico: מֶ֗לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־כִּסֵּא־דִ֑ין מְזָרֶ֖ה בְעֵינָ֣יו כָּל־רָֽע׃

controles.web: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
controles.kjv: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
controles.livre: O rei, ao se sentar no trono do juízo, com seus olhos dissipa todo mal.

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־יֹ֭אמַר זִכִּ֣יתִי לִבִּ֑י טָ֝הַ֗רְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִֽי׃

controles.web: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin?”
controles.kjv: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
controles.livre: Quem poderá dizer: “Purifiquei meu coração; estou limpo de meu pecado”?

versos.hebraico: אֶ֣בֶן וָ֭אֶבֶן אֵיפָ֣ה וְאֵיפָ֑ה תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the Lord.
controles.livre: Dois pesos e duas medidas, ambos são abominação ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: גַּ֣ם בְּ֭מַעֲלָלָיו יִתְנַכֶּר־נָ֑עַר אִם־זַ֖ךְ וְאִם־יָשָׁ֣ר פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
controles.kjv: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
controles.livre: Até o jovem é conhecido pelas suas ações, se sua obra for pura e correta.

versos.hebraico: אֹ֣זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת וְעַ֣יִן רֹאָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה גַם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.
controles.kjv: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the Lord hath made even both of them.
controles.livre: O ouvido que ouve e o olho que vê, o SENHOR os fez ambos.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תֶּֽאֱהַ֣ב שֵׁ֭נָה פֶּן־תִּוָּרֵ֑שׁ פְּקַ֖ח עֵינֶ֣יךָ שְֽׂבַֽע־לָֽחֶם׃

controles.web: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
controles.kjv: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
controles.livre: Não ames ao sono, para que não empobreças; abre teus olhos, e te fartarás de pão.

versos.hebraico: רַ֣ע רַ֭ע יֹאמַ֣ר הַקּוֹנֶ֑ה וְאֹזֵ֥ל ל֝֗וֹ אָ֣ז יִתְהַלָּֽל׃

controles.web: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
controles.kjv: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
controles.livre: Preço ruim, preço ruim, diz o comprador; mas quando vai embora, então se gaba.

versos.hebraico: יֵ֣שׁ זָ֭הָב וְרָב־פְּנִינִ֑ים וּכְלִ֥י יְ֝קָ֗ר שִׂפְתֵי־דָֽעַת׃

controles.web: There is gold and abundance of rubies; but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
controles.kjv: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
controles.livre: Há ouro, e muitos rubis; mas os lábios do conhecimento são joia preciosa.

versos.hebraico: לְֽקַח־בִּ֭גְדוֹ כִּי־עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּבְעַ֖ד נכרים חַבְלֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
controles.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
controles.livre: Toma a roupa daquele que fica por fiador de estranho; toma como penhor daquele que fica por fiador da estranha.

versos.hebraico: עָרֵ֣ב לָ֭אִישׁ לֶ֣חֶם שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝אַחַ֗ר יִמָּֽלֵא־פִ֥יהוּ חָצָֽץ׃

controles.web: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
controles.kjv: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
controles.livre: O pão da mentira é agradável ao homem; mas depois sua boca se encherá de pedregulhos.

versos.hebraico: מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּעֵצָ֣ה תִכּ֑וֹן וּ֝בְתַחְבֻּל֗וֹת עֲשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָֽה׃

controles.web: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
controles.kjv: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
controles.livre: Os planos são confirmados por meio do conselho; e com conselhos prudentes faze a guerra.

versos.hebraico: גּֽוֹלֶה־סּ֭וֹד הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָכִ֑יל וּלְפֹתֶ֥ה שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִתְעָרָֽב׃

controles.web: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
controles.kjv: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
controles.livre: Quem anda fofocando revela segredos; por isso não te envolvas com aquele que fala demais com seus lábios.

versos.hebraico: מְ֭קַלֵּל אָבִ֣יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ יִֽדְעַ֥ךְ נֵ֝ר֗וֹ באישון חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

controles.web: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
controles.kjv: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
controles.livre: Aquele que amaldiçoar a seu pai ou a sua mãe terá sua lâmpada apagada em trevas profundas.

versos.hebraico: נַ֭חֲלָה מבחלת בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ לֹ֣א תְבֹרָֽךְ׃

controles.web: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning, won’t be blessed in the end.
controles.kjv: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
controles.livre: A herança ganha apressadamente no princípio, seu fim não será abençoado.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תֹּאמַ֥ר אֲשַׁלְּמָה־רָ֑ע קַוֵּ֥ה לַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה וְיֹ֣שַֽׁע לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.
controles.kjv: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the Lord, and he shall save thee.
controles.livre: Não digas: Devolverei o mal; Espera pelo SENHOR, e ele te livrará.

versos.hebraico: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה אֶ֣בֶן וָאָ֑בֶן וּמֹאזְנֵ֖י מִרְמָ֣ה לֹא־טֽוֹב׃

controles.web: Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
controles.kjv: Divers weights are an abomination unto the Lord; and a false balance is not good.
controles.livre: O SENHOR abomina pesos falsificados; e balanças enganosas não são boas.

versos.hebraico: מֵיהוָ֥ה מִצְעֲדֵי־גָ֑בֶר וְ֝אָדָ֗ם מַה־יָּבִ֥ין דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?
controles.kjv: Man’s goings are of the Lord; how can a man then understand his own way?
controles.livre: Os passos do homem pertencem ao SENHOR; como, pois, o homem entenderá seu caminho?

versos.hebraico: מוֹקֵ֣שׁ אָ֭דָם יָ֣לַע קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְאַחַ֖ר נְדָרִ֣ים לְבַקֵּֽר׃

controles.web: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
controles.kjv: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
controles.livre: Armadilha ao homem é prometer precipitadamente algo como sagrado, e somente depois pensar na seriedade dos votos que fez .

versos.hebraico: מְזָרֶ֣ה רְ֭שָׁעִים מֶ֣לֶךְ חָכָ֑ם וַיָּ֖שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם אוֹפָֽן׃

controles.web: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
controles.kjv: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
controles.livre: O rei sábio espalha os perversos, e os atropela.

versos.hebraico: נֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה נִשְׁמַ֣ת אָדָ֑ם חֹ֝פֵ֗שׂ כָּל־חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃

controles.web: The spirit of man is Yahweh’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
controles.kjv: The spirit of man is the candle of the Lord, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
controles.livre: O espírito humano é uma lâmpada do SENHOR, que examina todo o interior do ventre.

versos.hebraico: חֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יִצְּרוּ־מֶ֑לֶךְ וְסָעַ֖ד בַּחֶ֣סֶד כִּסְאֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
controles.kjv: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
controles.livre: A bondade e a fidelidade protegem o rei; e com bondade seu trono é sustentado.

versos.hebraico: תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בַּחוּרִ֣ים כֹּחָ֑ם וַהֲדַ֖ר זְקֵנִ֣ים שֵׂיבָֽה׃

controles.web: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
controles.kjv: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.
controles.livre: A beleza dos jovens é sua força; e a honra dos velhos é seus cabelos brancos.

versos.hebraico: חַבֻּר֣וֹת פֶּ֭צַע תמריק בְּרָ֑ע וּ֝מַכּ֗וֹת חַדְרֵי־בָֽטֶן׃

controles.web: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
controles.kjv: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
controles.livre: Os golpes das feridas purificam os maus; como também as pancadas no interior do corpo.
